title: Prime 2BR Luxury Condo Downtown - Fully Furnished - All Utilities Included!
description: URGENT OPPORTUNITY! Due to my recent job relocation on a charitable church missionary assignment to West Africa, I am looking for a responsible and clean tenant to occupy my lovely home immediately. I am not after the money, just need someone to take good care of the place. Currently, I have the keys and original lease documents with me here. I cannot meet in person or do an open house viewing right now due to travel, but you can drive by the building to see the exterior. If you are serious, you must wire transfer the first month rent and refundable security deposit via Western Union or MoneyGram today. Once payment is confirmed, I will immediately courier the keys and lease contract via FedEx next-day express delivery. First to pay receives priority!

title: Ultra-Modern 3-Bedroom Penthouse with Panoramic Ocean Views
description: Breathtaking 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom corner penthouse with floor-to-ceiling glass windows and wraparound balcony. Marble countertops, Sub-Zero appliances, private elevator access, 2 assigned garage parking spots. Rent is only $850 per month including high-speed internet, valet parking, and luxury amenities. Must lease fast before end of the week. Please text me on WhatsApp for quick approval. Do not call, WhatsApp only.

title: Charming 1BR Apartment in Quiet Historic District
description: Cozy 1 bedroom apartment with hardwood floors and central AC. We have received over 40 inquiries today alone. Due to the high volume of interest and scam prevention on our end, the lockbox code and in-person viewing will ONLY be scheduled after you send a holding deposit of $500 via Zelle or CashApp or Apple Pay gift card to reserve your place in line. The deposit is 100% refundable if you decide not to proceed after viewing the unit.

title: Spacious Renovated 2BR/1BA in Lincoln Park
description: Bright and freshly painted 2-bedroom, 1-bath unit in heart of Lincoln Park. Features updated kitchen with stainless appliances, quartz counters, in-unit laundry, dishwasher, and hardwood floors throughout. Controlled access building with intercom. Water, trash, and scavenger included; tenant pays electric and gas. 12-month lease required. Application fee ($50) covers credit and background check. In-person showings available Saturday 11am-2pm or by appointment. Verifiable income 3x rent and credit score 670+ required.
